newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Spector plans 2.0 bln BFR capital rise.
newsitem.headline: Spector plans 2.0 bln BFR capital rise.

text.p: Belgium's Spector Photo Group NV said it planned to raise its share capital by about two billion Belgian francs in order to finance the purchase of Germany's Porst's activities and Interdiscount France.

The capital increase will be conducted through the issue of preferential subscription rights to existing shareholders, and Porst Holding will use its preferential rights to subscribe to 50.2 percent of the capital increase, Post said in a statement ahead of a news conference here.
In addition, Spector Photo intends to issue subordinated, convertible bonds with a warrant for an amount between 1.0 billion and 1.5 billion Belgian francs.
Earlier today trading in Porst and Distefora was suspended by the Swiss Exchange and on Thursday the Brussels bourse suspended trading in Spector until Monday.
